anika: Sales asked for a staged rollout plan for auditor exports: MVP = signed bundle + NDA gating; GA = console + sampling controls. Need a short launch checklist.

sam: MVP items: /exports endpoint, manifest + KMS-sig, signed URL TTL=1h, NDA gating, revocation path.

lina: BYOK note: provide wrapped-key fingerprints + KMS attestation statement only. No unwrapping. Make limitation explicit in manifest.

omar: Ops: add snapshot pre-warm for SLA tenants, quota guard, and metric export_snapshot_estimate_seconds. Estimate storage uplift per snapshot requested.

legal-bot: Legal: NDA + export acceptance form required before any bundle generation. Cross-region exports require explicit consent with signer email + timestamp in manifest.

ops-bot: Action created: runbook "staged-audit-export-rollout" assigned to #product/#security/#sre.

anika: Launch criteria (MVP): product spec + legal signoff, endpoint + manifest sig, NDA gating, revocation + alerts, docs for auditors. Canaries: 1 bank customer. I'll add to backlog.
